decisions.statement: One JSON document holds every feature the window has observed.
A feature's name names the field that feature's last observation is held under.
A feature invents the names of the counts that feature keeps.
The document is read whole, and a reader parses it for itself.
No question reaches a field inside this document.
A write replaces the whole document rather than adding to the document.
No author writes an observation here by hand.

definition: the document holding what a window last observed of each of its features
